title: Retain PR203 source proof, certificate reconciliation and credit (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

**Research consolidation; no new κ.**

- Authenticates all 29 paths (`195,812` bytes) in huxint's [#203](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/203) (`d2873e20750d0949d2ad75cbc4cd82b5b1a74e84`, `research/percent-exponent-architecture`) offline via raw Git commit, tree, and blob identities in `research/pr203-retention-receipt/SOURCE-PROOF.json` (`60` Git objects: `6` commits, `21` trees, `33` blobs).
- Authenticates the pinned upstream inputs from Rohan Arun's (@rohanarun) [#187](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/187) (`201737a1ec4f936e166e2481fb9e88104cb2ccc7:research/source-assisted-bit-bootstrap/emitted-physical.json`, retained via `archive/pr-reconciliation100-20261013`) and Avi Eisenberg's (@ikeboy) [#193](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/193) (`187e1010ac8b259af8e9b5166f68b64bc27b4b47:research/source-assisted-v4/certificate.json`, `scripts/experiments/balanced_fano.py`, and `scripts/experiments/fano_completion.py`, retained via `archive/pr-reconciliation-next100-20261013`).
- Recomputes and reconciles all four exact screens in PR203 against the saved certificates and the Round-9 replay log (`research/community-round9-audit/pr203-replay.log.txt`):
  1. `ceiling-certificate.json`: `complex-pr193` and `bit-pr187` fixed-itinerary and free-center ceilings (`a < 0.008868` and `a < 0.008898`), all `182` finite odd-cube cases (`133` positive-deficit cases, scan SHA256 `cebf8348bf5dc03f528e809648ed3062340b1d7aaf7b47924e157659f0e374ac`, `a < 0.005164` for destructive-parity and `a < 0.008094` for arbitrary local chains), `p >= 30` tail bound, Walsh projector and $K^2 = \frac{1}{4} I$ checks (`d in (3, 5, 7)`), 5 copied $t$-star binary span checks, and `(m=3, W=30)` vs `(m=3, W=31)` one-deficit bit saving bounds.
  2. `center-basis-certificate.json`: rational Gram invertibility and sharp $\mathbb{F}_2$ support rank $h - 2$ (loss floor $h(h-2)$) for `p in (5, 6, 11, 13, 16)`, `p = 4` excluded-domain control (`4 < 6`), and all $3^{10} - 1 = 59,048$ nonzero ternary coefficient vectors at `p = 5` (support rank $\ge 8$).
  3. `triangular_obstruction.py`: exact common-triangular-flag basis-conjugation and commutativity rejection controls (`rank_lower_bound = W * m`).
  4. `enumeration-controls.json`, `fano-all-permutations.json`, `fano-reuse-certificate.json`, and `discovery/receipts/vector-k*.json`: 8 direct full-word brute-force controls, all 87 chronological balanced-Fano stub-reuse topologies, the 16 obstruction-preserving cases matching the 16 `PASS k/16` lines in `pr203-replay.log.txt`, and the 5 block-vector solver receipts ($k = 2, 3, 4$).
- Restores missing PR203 credit in `CONTRIBUTORS.md` without changing ledger dispositions or claiming a new construction or fresh C++/solver replay.

## Task & Coordination

- **Assigned task:** `overlap-receipt` (`consolidation` track, seed `563d7e55de5891491987f38cb6b1508a`, scope key `757723e3fd38f20fa774`, priority revision `5`).
- **Base commit:** `534de584c7c9b7abd621a0d8cec959d021e5b510`.
- **Coordination claim:** https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-18961859

## Verification

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr203-retention-receipt
```

- Runs `verify.py` and `test_verify.py` (`21` tests: `1` positive case and `20` coverage, corruption, provenance, ceiling, center-basis, and Fano screen rejection controls) under `-I -O -B`.
- Verified in an exported directory with no `.git` and `PATH=/nonexistent` under Python `3.12.9` and `3.14.4`.
